description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

> The timestamp must be the start of a minute.

description.zh: 采样间隔，单位：秒。必须是60秒的倍数，默认60s。返回结果可缩放。
description.en: The sampling interval, in seconds. The value must be a multiple of 60. The default value is 60.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址。
description.en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance to query.

description.zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地。
description.en:
The service region. Valid values:

- **cn**: Chinese mainland.

- **cn-hongkong**: Outside Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The start of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

> The timestamp must be the start of a minute.
